title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Fixed hosting/matching being broken by a recent game update (NetHostGameService/StartRunLobby API changes). Added SteamID64 support to the ban list: add a ban directly by ID, or import/export your list as a plain text file (with nickname/reason fields) via Windows' native file picker. Fixed the community name field recording every keystroke into its autocomplete history instead of only once you're done typing.
